info.name: OneChurch API
info.description: All application endpoints from the current project, grouped by resource. Set baseUrl (Docker default: http://localhost:8081), username and password, then run Authentication > Login and save JWT. Protected requests inherit Bearer {{token}}. Creation requests save resource IDs as collection variables. Set relatedPersonId manually to a different existing person. Use test data and send mutation requests deliberately; a full collection run changes passwords, disables accounts, ends relationships and deletes life events. Framework debug/profiler routes are excluded. See postman/README.md for setup and current application blockers.

request.description: Use an existing enabled account. Saves the JWT to the collection token variable. Credentials are intentionally blank.
POST /api/people. Saves the returned id to personId.
POST /api/families. Saves the returned id to familyId.
POST /api/families/{familyId}/addresses. Saves the returned id to familyAddressId.

request.description: POST /api/people/{personId}/employment. Saves the returned id to employmentId.
POST /api/people/{personId}/relationships. Saves the returned id to relationshipId. Set relatedPersonId to a second, different existing person.
POST /api/relationships/{id}/end. Changes or removes data; run deliberately against test records.
POST /api/users. Saves the returned id to userId. The login account must already exist; user creation requires authentication.
PUT /api/users/{id}/password. Changes or removes data; run deliberately against test records.
POST /api/users/{id}/disable. Changes or removes data; run deliberately against test records.
DELETE /api/users/{id}/roles/{roleId}. Changes or removes data; run deliberately against test records.
POST /api/roles. Saves the returned id to roleId.
DELETE /api/roles/{roleId}/permissions/{permissionId}. Changes or removes data; run deliberately against test records.
POST /api/permissions. Saves the returned id to permissionId.
POST /api/life-events. Saves the returned id to lifeEventId.
